name: Create and retain a tracker entry with bookmaker
description: Verifies a tracker entry can include a bookmaker and remains saved after refresh.
steps: Open Tracker from mobile navigation
Enter a selection, race, stake, decimal odds and Sportsbet as bookmaker
Save the selection
Refresh the page
expected: The saved selection and bookmaker remain visible after refresh.

name: Use race tools, Race Centre and persistent racing notes
covers: each-way gross return and net result
manual data source and update timestamp disclosure
BetMakers provider onboarding checklist and local progress persistence
provider API security and commercial rights guidance
BetMakers acquisition caveat and change-of-control guidance
missing race and runner detail warnings
data readiness is not official source verification
runner comparison from manually entered numeric ratings
highest lowest and average user-entered ratings
analysis does not predict winners or recommend bets
description: Verifies calculators, notebook and the new structured race workspace remain usable on mobile.
steps: Open Race Centre from mobile navigation
Review the racing data connection status and supported feed categories
Open the BetMakers provider onboarding checklist
Review the API requirements, ownership caveat and credential safety warning
Tick a preparation item and refresh the page to confirm checklist progress is retained
Create a race workspace and leave distance, source and track details blank
Review the data readiness panel and confirm missing information is listed
Add two runners with the same name and confirm a duplicate warning appears
Open the official provider documentation links
Create a race workspace with a meeting, venue, date and race number
Add three runners with manually entered form, running styles and numeric ratings, leaving one runner unrated
Confirm runner details and entered-rating ordering are visible
Review the Runner comparison panel and confirm the highest, average and lowest entered ratings are shown
Confirm the unrated runner is excluded and a missing-rating warning is displayed
Confirm the panel states that ratings are user-entered and does not predict winners or recommend bets
Export the race file, refresh and confirm the race and runners remain
Remove one runner and confirm it is gone
Open Race tools and verify manual odds comparison and each-way calculations still work
expected: The provider status clearly reports that no live feed is connected; the BetMakers preparation checklist retains its locally saved progress; technical and commercial prerequisites and credential safety are visible; and manual race workspaces and existing race tools remain usable.

name: Update a result and remove an entry
description: Verifies a saved selection can be settled, included in calculations, and deleted with confirmation.
setup: Create a tracker entry named Settlement Runner with stake 10 and decimal odds 2.00
steps: Change Settlement Runner result to Won
Confirm returns and net result update
Delete Settlement Runner and confirm
Refresh the page
expected: The entry is removed and no longer contributes to tracker totals after refresh.

name: Review insights and handle an unavailable AI service
description: Verifies the Insights lab returns a cautious record review and shows a useful error when the service is unavailable.
steps: Open Insights with no saved tracker entries
Choose Review my record
Wait for the review response
expected: A clear error message explains that insights are temporarily unavailable and that tracker data remains safe.

name: Use learning, challenges and bankroll safety controls
description: Verifies learning areas and bankroll boundaries remain accessible and saved on mobile.
steps: Open Safer play
Set starting bankroll and daily limit
Refresh and confirm both values remain
Review weekly limit and Australian support resources
Visit Learn and Challenges
expected: Starting bankroll, daily and weekly limits persist and recorded stakes are shown against the configured limits.

name: Export and restore a complete Punters HQ backup
description: Verifies a single backup file preserves all supported device-local Punters HQ records and can restore them on another browser.
steps: Create at least one tracker entry, one racing note, one race workspace with runners and change a provider checklist item
Set bankroll, daily limit and weekly limit values
Open Tracker and export a full backup
Confirm a JSON backup file is downloaded
Open a clean browser profile or another device with the staging app and choose Restore a full backup
Select the exported JSON file and confirm the restore
Refresh the app and inspect tracker, notes, race workspace, bankroll limits and provider checklist
Try selecting an unrelated JSON file and confirm it is rejected without changing saved records
expected: All exported records and settings are restored and remain after refresh. An unrelated or invalid file is rejected before any saved data is changed.
